rows.name: Cut median case review time by 25% on cases handled with the AI assistant
rows.description: Compare median analyst handling time on assistant-reviewed cases against a pre-launch baseline. Measured monthly from the case-management system's audit log.
rows.currentState: Scope agreed. Baseline work is waiting on audit log access.

rows.name: Reach 85% agreement between assistant recommendations and final analyst decisions on a 500-case sample
rows.description: Draw a stratified sample of assistant-reviewed cases and have senior investigators review them blind. Report agreement overall and by case type.

rows.name: Publish a monthly AI assistant scorecard from November with no manual steps
rows.description: A BI tool dashboard showing handling time, agreement rate and override reasons. Sent to the manager and operations leadership on the first working day of each month.

rows.name: Ship a v1 case-management data model covering 100% of active case types
rows.description: One documented model in the data warehouse for cases, alerts, accounts, devices and outcomes. Replaces the ad hoc case queries each analyst maintains today.
rows.currentState: Source mapping about 70% done.

rows.name: Reduce closed cases with a missing outcome label from 18% to under 5%
rows.description: Outcome labels feed every model and loss estimate the team builds. Fix the gap at the point of case closure so new cases arrive labelled.

rows.name: Run automated data-quality tests on the 10 core case tables with a 95% pass rate
rows.description: Tests for nulls, duplicates and late-arriving outcomes run on every load. Failures alert the analytics engineer on call.

rows.name: Replace the 4 manual weekly fraud reports with automated BI tool dashboards
rows.description: Each report is rebuilt on data warehouse tables and run in parallel with the spreadsheet version for two weeks before the spreadsheet is retired.
rows.currentState: Inventory done. First dashboard is blocked on data access.

rows.name: Cut weekly reporting prep time from 6 hours to under 1 hour
rows.description: Measured from the reporting analyst's own time log. Achieved through scheduled extracts and removing manual reconciliation steps.

rows.name: Alert the team within 24 hours when any of 3 key fraud KPIs breaches its threshold
rows.description: Covers chargeback rate, first-payment default rate and account-takeover case volume. Thresholds are signed off by the manager.

rows.name: Device risk score reaches an AUC of at least 0.80 on a held-out Q3 sample
rows.description: A first device-level fraud risk score built on device age, SIM changes and location signals. Validated on cases the model has not seen.
rows.currentState: Waiting on the device telemetry extract before modelling can start.

rows.name: Score 100% of new device activations within 5 minutes
rows.description: Scores land in the data warehouse and the case-management system so investigators see them on new cases.

rows.name: Review 90% of top-decile device risk flags within 48 hours
rows.description: Needs a written investigation SOP and trained investigators. Measured from flag creation to the first case note.

rows.name: Fraud loss definitions signed off by finance and risk by 30 October
rows.description: One agreed taxonomy covering confirmed, suspected and recovered fraud losses, so every team reports the same number.
rows.currentState: Draft taxonomy shared with finance; one open question on recoveries.

rows.name: Quantify Q1 to Q3 2026 fraud losses by typology, each with a confidence range
rows.description: Combine confirmed losses from written-off balances with a modelled estimate of undetected fraud. Every figure carries a range, not a point estimate.

rows.name: Request read access to the case-management system's audit log tables
rows.description: Needed to compute handling time per case from open, assign and close events.
rows.currentState: Access request is with the data owner for approval. Blocked until it is granted; the baseline can't start without it.

rows.name: Build the pre-launch baseline of median review time by case type
rows.description: Eight weeks of history before the assistant went live, split by in-scope case type.

rows.name: Agree with the investigations team which case types are in scope for the time study
rows.currentState: Agreed: account takeover, first-payment default and identity fraud cases.

rows.name: Design the stratified 500-case sample for the agreement study
rows.description: Stratify by case type and assistant confidence band so low-volume case types are still represented.
rows.currentState: Sampling frame drafted. Checking the case-type weights against last quarter's volumes.

rows.name: Write the labelling guide for the blind second review
rows.description: Defines what counts as agreement, partial agreement and override for each recommendation type.
rows.currentState: Draft ready, but the two senior investigators who need to review it are tied up with the case backlog until late October.

rows.name: Run the blind second review on the sample and log every disagreement
Build the AI assistant scorecard dashboard in the BI tool
rows.description: Handling time, agreement rate and top override reasons, refreshed monthly.

rows.name: Get operations leadership sign-off on the scorecard metric definitions
Map case-management system tables to the target entities
rows.description: Target entities are case, alert, account, device and outcome.
rows.currentState: About 70% mapped. Schema documentation for the disputes module is missing; asked the system admin and waiting on a reply.

rows.name: Write the data-model spec and review it with the investigations team
Build the case fact table and its dimensions in the data warehouse
Update the investigation SOP to make an outcome label mandatory at case closure
rows.description: Includes the matching change to the closure form in the case-management system.
rows.currentState: SOP draft circulated. Needs the operations manager's sign-off before the closure form change can go live.

rows.name: Write data-quality tests for null case IDs, duplicate alerts and late-arriving outcomes
rows.currentState: Tests written for 4 of the 10 core tables.

rows.name: Send a nightly data-quality summary to the whole team
rows.description: Short digest of test failures by table, so analysts know which numbers to treat with care that day.
rows.currentState: Suggested during weekly planning; waiting for the manager to accept or reject.

rows.name: Inventory the 4 weekly reports, their data sources and who reads them
rows.currentState: Inventory complete; one report has no regular readers and may be dropped.

rows.name: Rebuild the weekly fraud overview report as a BI tool dashboard
rows.currentState: Two of five tiles done. Blocked on access to the collections schema in the data warehouse; the request has been open for a week.

rows.name: Schedule daily refreshes of the reporting extracts in the data warehouse
rows.description: Removes the manual Monday-morning extract that takes most of the current prep time.

rows.name: Propose alert thresholds for the 3 key fraud KPIs from 12 months of history
Build a real-time KPI alert feed into the team chat
rows.currentState: Rejected by the manager: a daily check is enough to meet the 24-hour target this quarter.

rows.name: Request the device telemetry extract from the device platform team
rows.currentState: Request submitted. The platform team says the data-sharing agreement needs legal review first, so this is blocked until legal responds.

rows.name: Engineer device-age, SIM-change and location-change features
Validate the device risk model on the Q3 holdout and write the validation report
rows.description: Covers discrimination, calibration and stability by region, ready for independent model review.

rows.name: Agree scoring latency and hosting requirements with the engineering team
rows.currentState: First meeting held. Engineering has not yet confirmed they have capacity this quarter, which holds up the design.

rows.name: Draft the investigation SOP for high-risk device flags
rows.description: Covers triage order, evidence to collect and when to escalate or restrict an account.

rows.name: Draft the fraud loss taxonomy and definitions
rows.currentState: Draft shared. Finance hasn't replied on how to treat recovered amounts, which is holding up the final version.

rows.name: Get finance and risk sign-off on the fraud loss definitions
Pull written-off balances linked to confirmed fraud cases
rows.currentState: Query written. Totals are about 4% off finance's write-off ledger; working through the gap.

rows.name: Estimate undetected fraud losses with confidence ranges
Request match data from the credit bureau partner to size synthetic-identity losses
rows.currentState: Raised in a one-to-one; waiting for the manager to accept or reject.
